_comment: pac-host config. Replaces the separate mtmesh + trial-logger PM2 apps. PATHS ARE ABSOLUTE ON PURPOSE: mtmesh resolved './payloads' against its own cwd, so under a shared host a relative path would silently move the butler queue and image store to a new directory. Under this host, cwd belongs to the host.

mesh._timing_comment: EVERY timeout/delay/interval/cap is declared HERE. No inline fallbacks, no constants in code. There is no schema timeout: the schema is a file, not radio traffic.
mesh._schema_comment: The config schema is a FILE generated at firmware build time from CONFIG_FIELDS and served instantly. STATIC per build, NEVER pulled over the radio — the old over-air pull was 7 round trips at 30-90s each and never once completed.
mesh._devices_comment: OUR alarm devices — the DECLARED half of the device registry behind GET /v1/mesh/devices. Distinct from 'units' below, which only holds live/dev overrides and so cannot answer 'is this ours'. Declaring a unit keeps it in the device list while it is ASLEEP; the other half is learned from 260/261 traffic and persisted. The gateway !2687afb1 is deliberately absent: it is our radio, not one of our devices.
mesh._labels_comment: LABELS ENCODE LOCATION and must be toggled on every physical swap, exactly like the short name. Inverted on 2026-07-25 when 8cee336b went to the garage and b80f came to the bench: only the short names and modes were switched. Verified against reported positions — 8cee336b is 2.501 km from b80f on bearing 301.2 deg (garage -> house).
